query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, i.submittedAt
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON i.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.companyName NOT LIKE 'Test%' AND s.companyName NOT LIKE 'Visibility%'
ORDER BY i.submittedAt ASC
LIMIT 25 OFFSET 20;
